info.title: API-DocTest-Create Realestate Listings Offer-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Offer API enables users to submit new offers for real estate listings efficiently. This endpoint allows real estate professionals and potential buyers to engage in the property market, facilitating the submission of competitive offers to sellers. Typical consumers include real estate agents, buyers, and property management companies seeking to enhance their offerings and streamline transactions. By utilizing this API, users can ensure their offers are promptly processed and accurately represented.

post.summary: Create a new offer for a listing.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new offer associated with a specific listing, enabling negotiation on pricing and terms. Utilize this functionality to enhance engagement with potential buyers or renters.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new offer listing. It must include all necessary fields required for processing the offer, ensuring compliance with the listing guidelines.
